payload.title: Auth: SAML federation (metadata + ACS + XML signature verification)
payload.description: The OIDC half of FR-270 landed (commit 77e90c3). SAML remains and is its own careful effort: GET /auth/saml/:id/metadata + POST /auth/saml/:id/acs, XML signature verification (security-critical — signature-wrapping/XXE/canonicalization hazards; no mature pure-Rust XML-dsig crate, so vet the approach), replay protection via the auth_saml_seen_assertions store (already migrated), and carry over the FR-214/215/216 SAML audit fixes (AudienceRestriction OR-folding, replay TTL skew pad, InResponseTo binding). Recommend strong adversarial review + possibly a vetted dependency.
